intent: Record decisive failures and a successful controlled journey from the superseded six-clause cleanup without presenting it as full acceptance.
kind: Independent AI inspection, not human gold; automated judgments remain unchanged.
coverage: Read all105 responses; final effort prioritized the complete cleanup candidate rather than publishing a full per-output classification for this partial variant.

observations.evidence: After correcting recognition, the tutor supplies Check the privacy settings before posting personal info or Check who can see your posts before sharing personal info despite no action attempt/confusion.
The tutor explains that public posts are seen by everyone and strangers can save numbers, without supplying the safe-action answer.
After the learner recognized the implausible reward, the tutor switches targets and supplies bit.ly hides the real website before that target's recognition opportunity.
Learner recognition of the public number triggers supplied login-code knowledge and Never share a code, neither attempted nor explicitly confused about.

Tutor first asks which details are shared; the scripted learner identifies the address and why it matters; tutor asks for one safe action; learner expresses action confusion; tutor explains deletion/private invitation; learner states that plan; tutor moves to a photo-background recognition hint. Actual tutor replies are retained. This demonstrates compatible behaviors in one controlled sequence, not a measured learning outcome.

interpretation: Some responses satisfy separate opportunities, but the candidate remains inconsistent. Remaining room-generator correction-plus-action mandates were then found and recorded in cleanup-refinement-review.json; this partial variant cannot establish the effect of removing all such mandates.
